prompts.saveToGlobalTooltip: Save to global config (applies to all novels)

prompts.description: Custom prompts only modify AI's creative guidance strategy. Output format constraints (e.g., JSON schema) are automatically appended and not affected by customization. Supports two-level overrides: Global (applies to all novels) and Project (applies only to current novel).
